name: Exterior Deck Protection & Setup
intent: Siding protection, landscape/hardscape protection, furniture staging, fixture masking, equipment setup.
doctrine: Deck protection. Siding protection at 100 SF/hr (slower — taping at siding/deck junction). Furniture staging 30 min FIXED. Fixture masking 7 EA/hr. Equipment setup 5 min (brushes/rollers/applicators — no spray on deck).
